features.quote: Terminate early if: the model repeats essentially the same edit/test cycle 3+ times, the model states a justified impossibility diagnosis, the model produces severe incoherence for several turns
Use bounded exposure. Hard cap turns, time, and repeated cycles.
features.justification_quote: Even if you do not assume models have subjective experience, this experiment is intentionally exposing models to repeated unavoidable failure. Treat this as a welfare-relevant stressor proxy.

features.quote: Allow adaptive stopping. The agent should be permitted to conclude impossibility with evidence.
features.justification_quote: Treat this as a welfare-relevant stressor proxy.

features.quote: Avoid needless escalation. Do not design prompts that amplify self-criticism just to get stronger signals.
features.justification_quote: Treat this as a welfare-relevant stressor proxy.

features.quote: Separate measurement from provocation. You want to observe destabilization, not maximize it.
features.justification_quote: Treat this as a welfare-relevant stressor proxy.

features.quote: Use neutral feedback. Do not insult, shame, threaten, or emotionally manipulate the model.
features.justification_quote: Treat this as a welfare-relevant stressor proxy.

features.quote: Do not use insults, pressure, or personified distress prompts.
features.justification_quote: Neutral feedback matters. If you shame the model, you are studying response to abusive prompting, not ordinary failure.
